run_kuka_cam_gym_env: run the KukaCamGymEnv example to test the Kuka robot camera gym environment with debug sliders
create_kuka_environment: create a KukaCamGymEnv instance with renders enabled and continuous action space
add_debug_parameters: add user debug parameters for posX, posY, posZ, yaw, and fingerAngle sliders
read_debug_parameters: read user debug parameter values from the PyBullet environment sliders into an action list
step_environment: step the KukaCamGymEnv environment with an action and retrieve state, reward, done, and info
